name: Hirose Rumi
source:
A junior colleague of Eri’s at work.
She’s clumsy with her hands and can’t cook; the tea she brews is either too strong or too weak, so she’s not even useful as a tea server.
She has a tendency to become violent when drunk (she has no memory of what happens when she’s intoxicated).
Due to her behavior while drunk at the welcome party, the male employees don’t see her as a woman.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ01005551.html/]dlsite[/url]]
